findings.title: Cache is not re-checked after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Multiple goroutines can concurrently observe a nil entryPointAssetsCache under the read lock, then queue on the write lock at line 48. Because the locked section does not re-check the cache, every queued goroutine re-reads and parses assets-manifest.json, overwrites the cache, and blocks other callers while holding the exclusive lock. A cold-start burst therefore defeats the cache and serializes redundant file I/O. After acquiring the lock, return the cached value when cfg.Env is not Dev and the cache is now populated, while preserving the reload behavior in Dev mode.

findings.title: No concurrent regression test for the data-race fix
findings.body: The change synchronizes entryPointAssetsCache but adds no test that calls GetWebAssets concurrently, so CI running with the race detector has no new coverage for the simultaneous cache-miss/cache-hit path that previously raced. Add a same-package test using a valid temporary assets manifest and a non-Dev configuration that launches multiple concurrent GetWebAssets calls, properly resetting the global cache between tests, and verifies all callers succeed with the expected assets.
